_meta.description: Portfolio fee schema. This is a template only — never write data to this file.

modelid.description: Unique portfolio identifier — must match modelid in modelportfolio.json

portfolio_name.description: Portfolio display name — must match modelname in modelportfolio.json

investment_management_fee.description: Fee charged by the investment manager for managing the portfolio

estimated_underlying_management_fees_and.description: Estimated fees and costs of the underlying funds or securities held in the portfolio

estimated_managed_portfolio_cash_investm.description: Estimated fee applied to the cash component of the managed portfolio

performance_fee.description: Performance fee charged by the investment manager. Null if no performance fee applies.

estimated_underlying_performance_fee.description: Estimated performance fees charged within underlying funds held by the portfolio. Null if none.

estimated_gross_transaction_costs.description: Estimated costs incurred when buying and selling assets within the portfolio

estimated_buy_spread.description: Estimated cost applied when purchasing units in the portfolio

estimated_sell_spread.description: Estimated cost applied when redeeming units in the portfolio

flags.description: Populated by doc-ingestion agent — do not edit manually
